apple_pie.name: Classic Apple Pie
apple_pie.instructions: Prepare the pie crust, fill it with sliced apples mixed with sugar and cinnamon, cover with the top crust, and bake until golden brown.

apple_pie.name: Cinnamon Apple Pie
apple_pie.instructions: Mix sliced apples with brown sugar and spices. Place inside the pastry crust and bake until the apples are soft and the crust is golden.

apple_pie.name: Caramel Apple Pie
apple_pie.instructions: Fill the pie crust with seasoned apples, drizzle with caramel sauce, cover and bake until golden.

apple_pie.name: Apple Crumble Pie
apple_pie.instructions: Place seasoned apples in a baking dish, cover with an oat crumble mixture, and bake until golden and bubbling.

cheesecake.name: Classic New York Cheesecake
cheesecake.instructions: Prepare the biscuit base, mix the cheesecake filling, pour over the base and bake until set. Chill before serving.

cheesecake.name: Strawberry Cheesecake
cheesecake.instructions: Prepare a cheesecake base and filling, bake until set, cool completely and top with fresh strawberries.

cheesecake.name: Mango Cheesecake
cheesecake.instructions: Prepare the biscuit base, combine cream cheese with mango pulp, chill or bake until set and decorate with mango pieces.

cheesecake.name: Blueberry Cheesecake
cheesecake.instructions: Make the biscuit crust and cheesecake filling, bake until firm, chill and finish with blueberry topping.

chicken_curry.name: Indian Chicken Curry
chicken_curry.instructions: Cook onions with ginger and garlic, add spices and tomatoes, add chicken and simmer until fully cooked.

chicken_curry.name: South Indian Chicken Curry
chicken_curry.instructions: Prepare a spiced coconut gravy with curry leaves and spices. Add chicken and cook until tender.

chicken_curry.name: Butter Chicken
chicken_curry.instructions: Cook chicken with spices, prepare a creamy tomato gravy and simmer the chicken in the sauce.

chicken_curry.name: Thai Chicken Curry
chicken_curry.instructions: Cook curry paste with coconut milk, add chicken and vegetables, then simmer until the chicken is cooked.

french_fries.name: Classic French Fries
french_fries.instructions: Cut potatoes into strips, soak and dry them well, then fry until crispy and season with salt.

french_fries.name: Garlic French Fries
french_fries.instructions: Fry potato strips until crispy and toss them with garlic, parsley and salt.

french_fries.name: Peri Peri Fries
french_fries.instructions: Fry potato strips until golden and crispy, then coat with peri peri seasoning.

french_fries.name: Cheese Fries
french_fries.instructions: Prepare crispy fries, top with melted cheese and garnish with spring onion.

fried_rice.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
fried_rice.instructions: Stir-fry vegetables, add cooked rice and soy sauce, then toss everything together over high heat.

fried_rice.name: Chicken Fried Rice
fried_rice.instructions: Cook chicken and vegetables, add egg and rice, then stir-fry with soy sauce.

fried_rice.name: Egg Fried Rice
fried_rice.instructions: Scramble eggs, add cooked rice and seasonings, then stir-fry until well combined.

fried_rice.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
fried_rice.instructions: Stir-fry vegetables, add rice and Schezwan sauce, then cook over high heat.

hamburger.name: Classic Beef Burger
hamburger.instructions: Grill the beef patty, toast the bun and assemble with lettuce, tomato, onion and cheese.

hamburger.name: Chicken Burger
hamburger.instructions: Cook the chicken patty thoroughly, toast the bun and assemble with vegetables and sauce.

hamburger.name: Veggie Burger
hamburger.instructions: Cook the vegetable patty, toast the bun and assemble with fresh vegetables and cheese.

hamburger.name: Cheese Burger
hamburger.instructions: Grill the patty, place cheese on top while hot, then assemble the burger with vegetables.

hot_dog.name: Classic Hot Dog
hot_dog.instructions: Cook the sausage, place it in a toasted bun and add mustard, ketchup and onion.

hot_dog.name: Cheese Hot Dog
hot_dog.instructions: Cook the sausage, place it in the bun, add cheese and heat until melted.

hot_dog.name: Chili Hot Dog
hot_dog.instructions: Cook the sausage, place it in the bun and top with chili sauce, onion and cheese.

hot_dog.name: Vegetarian Hot Dog
hot_dog.instructions: Cook the vegetarian sausage and serve in a toasted bun with fresh vegetables and mustard.

ice_cream.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
ice_cream.instructions: Whisk milk, cream, sugar and vanilla, chill the mixture and churn until creamy.

ice_cream.name: Chocolate Ice Cream
ice_cream.instructions: Combine milk, cream, cocoa and sugar, chill thoroughly and churn until smooth.

ice_cream.name: Mango Ice Cream
ice_cream.instructions: Mix mango pulp with cream and condensed milk, freeze until firm and creamy.

ice_cream.name: Strawberry Ice Cream
ice_cream.instructions: Blend strawberries with the dairy ingredients, chill and churn or freeze until creamy.

omelette.name: Classic Omelette
omelette.instructions: Beat the eggs with seasoning, cook in butter over medium heat and fold when almost set.

omelette.name: Masala Omelette
omelette.instructions: Beat eggs with chopped vegetables and spices, then cook on a hot pan until fully set.

omelette.name: Cheese Omelette
omelette.instructions: Cook beaten eggs in butter, add cheese and fold the omelette when the cheese begins to melt.

omelette.name: Vegetable Omelette
omelette.instructions: Cook the vegetables, add beaten eggs and cheese, then fold once the omelette is cooked.

pizza.name: Margherita Pizza
pizza.instructions: Spread tomato sauce over the dough, add mozzarella and basil, then bake until the crust is golden.

pizza.name: Vegetable Pizza
pizza.instructions: Top the dough with sauce, vegetables and cheese, then bake until the crust is crisp.

pizza.name: Chicken Pizza
pizza.instructions: Add tomato sauce, cooked chicken, vegetables and cheese to the dough and bake until golden.

pizza.name: Pepperoni Pizza
pizza.instructions: Spread sauce on the dough, add cheese and pepperoni, sprinkle oregano and bake until bubbly.

sushi.name: Vegetable Sushi Roll
sushi.instructions: Spread sushi rice over nori, add vegetables, roll tightly and slice into pieces.

sushi.name: California Roll
sushi.instructions: Spread rice over nori, add crab, avocado and cucumber, roll firmly and cut into pieces.

sushi.name: Salmon Sushi
sushi.instructions: Prepare seasoned sushi rice, place salmon and cucumber over nori, roll and slice carefully.

sushi.name: Avocado Sushi
sushi.instructions: Place sushi rice and sliced avocado on nori, add cucumber, roll tightly and garnish with sesame seeds.
